scan_snapshots_range_check.name: scan_snapshots_range_check
scan_snapshots_range_check.value: ("scan_snapshots"."coverage" is null or "scan_snapshots"."coverage" between 0 and 100) and ("scan_snapshots"."health_score" is null or "scan_snapshots"."health_score" between 0 and 100) and "scan_snapshots"."maturity" between 0 and 100 and "scan_snapshots"."flaky_tests" >= 0

runs_summary_check.name: runs_summary_check
runs_summary_check.value: "runs"."total" >= 0 and "runs"."passed" >= 0 and "runs"."failed" >= 0 and "runs"."flaky" >= 0 and "runs"."skipped" >= 0 and "runs"."blocked" >= 0 and "runs"."unknown" >= 0

quarantine_ttf_resolution_check.name: quarantine_ttf_resolution_check
quarantine_ttf_resolution_check.value: "quarantine"."ttf_ms" is null or "quarantine"."resolved_at" is not null

execution_jobs_lease_check.name: execution_jobs_lease_check
execution_jobs_lease_check.value: "execution_jobs"."state" <> 'leased' or ("execution_jobs"."lease_id" is not null and "execution_jobs"."lease_owner" is not null and "execution_jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "execution_jobs"."fencing_token" > 0)

artifacts_evidence_check.name: artifacts_evidence_check
artifacts_evidence_check.value: "artifacts"."checksum_algorithm" = 'sha256' and "artifacts"."checksum" is not null and "artifacts"."checksum" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "artifacts"."size_bytes" is not null

report_subscriptions_quiet_hours_check.name: report_subscriptions_quiet_hours_check
report_subscriptions_quiet_hours_check.value: ("report_subscriptions"."quiet_start" IS NULL AND "report_subscriptions"."quiet_end" IS NULL) OR ("report_subscriptions"."quiet_start" IS NOT NULL AND "report_subscriptions"."quiet_end" IS NOT NULL AND "report_subscriptions"."quiet_start" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "report_subscriptions"."quiet_end" BETWEEN 0 AND 23 AND "report_subscriptions"."quiet_start" <> "report_subscriptions"."quiet_end")

genai_spans_counts_check.name: genai_spans_counts_check
genai_spans_counts_check.value: "genai_spans"."duration_ms" >= 0 AND ("genai_spans"."input_tokens" IS NULL OR "genai_spans"."input_tokens" >= 0) AND ("genai_spans"."output_tokens" IS NULL OR "genai_spans"."output_tokens" >= 0)

issue_links_created_check.name: issue_links_created_check
issue_links_created_check.value: "issue_links"."state" <> 'created' OR ("issue_links"."issue_key" IS NOT NULL AND "issue_links"."issue_url" IS NOT NULL)
